plan.notes: Official Utah Tech University 2025-2026 Catalog, Criminal Justice - Criminology Emphasis BA/BS graduation plan text PDF (program awarded as BA/BS). Semester totals as printed: 15 / 15 / 15 / 15 / 15 / 15 / 15 / 14 = 119, matching the printed 'Total Hours 119' — the source's own total is 119, not 120. Course titles verified against the official 2025-2026 Criminology Minor program text and the CJ AS program curriculum: CJ 1010 Introduction to Criminal Justice; CJ 1330 Criminal Law; CJ 1340 Criminal Investigation; CJ 3270 Criminology; CJ 3300 Research Methods in Criminology and Criminal Justice; SOC 3111 Research Methods; CJ 4150 Criminal Justice Reform; CJ 4200 Ethical Issues in Criminal Justice; CJ 4900 Current Issues in Criminal Justice; MATH 1040 Introduction to Statistics (MA); ENGL 1010 Introduction to Writing (EN); ENGL 2010 Interm Writing Selected Topics: (EN). 'MATH 0980', 'CJ 4790' are choice placeholders (credits as printed); titles not shown in the graduation plan — see the 2025-2026 catalog course descriptions. 'CJ Emphasis Elective: Upper Division' slots (numbered 1-8) are choice placeholders for upper-division emphasis courses — see the program text for the eligible list. Prerequisites not populated from the plan; see official course descriptions in the 2025-2026 catalog.
